answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 170574 Country: India Title: Property value to be considered for zakah calculation? Question: I have purchased a property whose amount I am suppose to give in 4 years in installments. This purchase and payment is completely interest free. Till now I have paid some 4 to 5 installments. So do I need to consider the money that I have paid till now in Zakat amount calculation? Answer ID: 170574 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1042/892/L=09/1440) There is no zakah on the amount which you have paid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
